evidence.cost_assumption: self_quant turnover cost diagnostics available; after-cost evidence remains weak
evidence.falsification: Do not accept a turnover/risk filter if it improves drawdown by destroying Rank IC or removing the economic payer.

variant_family_coverage.scope: ALPHA014 historical ordinary/knowledge/iteration records are mapped to this mechanism-family node; individual variants still require their own artifact review before promotion.

evidence.window: 20160101 through available IS evidence in Alpha014 library records

mechanism.complexity_penalty_reasoning: MA5 smoothing is a low-cost transform with evidence improvement; low-turnover gating adds a data-dependent condition that is not justified if it deletes rank ordering.
mechanism.dirac_style_forced_insight: The low-turnover branch shows that a tradability filter is not automatically a better factor: if the filter conditions away the volume-pressure state, it may reduce drawdown while inverting or weakening Rank IC.
mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Alpha014 tries to buy repair after return-delta pressure when open-volume correlation indicates liquidity-driven movement, but a filter that merely lowers turnover can also remove the payer signal if the payer is embedded in high-activity names.
mechanism.factor_expression: ((-1 * rank(delta(returns, 3))) * correlation(open, volume, 10)); revisions include MA5 smoothing and low-turnover gating.
mechanism.information_preserved_removed: Smoothing preserves the same random object while reducing path noise; low-turnover gating removes part of the liquidity-pressure payer and can turn a signal into a risk overlay rather than an alpha.
mechanism.payer: short-horizon liquidity demanders and traders extrapolating recent return deltas under volume pressure
mechanism.random_object: smoothed return-delta and open-volume correlation path state
mechanism.receiver: patient reversal or risk-managed stat-arb capital
mechanism.target_statistic: long-side return after smoothing and risk filter, with rank IC preserved

relations.note: The signal depends on a recent return-delta path and open-volume correlation state.
The economic interpretation is pressure repair after recent return movement.
Smooth5 still loses after costs, while low-turn gating reduces drawdown at the cost of ranking information.
Lower turnover is not sufficient if the filter removes the payer population.
Use this case to audit whether a risk filter preserves or removes the math object.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node before adding low-turnover or low-liquidity gates to a price-volume reversal factor.
Prefer a preserve/remove audit over assuming a smoother or lower-turnover variant is better.
A drawdown improvement that comes with negative Rank IC is an anti-pattern, not a promotion path.
Use smoothing as a cheap denoising candidate only when it preserves the original payer and improves after-cost evidence.
summary: Alpha014 shows a reusable failure boundary: smoothing a return-delta times open-volume correlation signal can improve candidate-level long-side evidence, but low-turnover filters may reduce drawdown while deleting the cross-sectional ranking signal.
title: Alpha014 smoothing and low-turnover tradeoff
